status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that, at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.
status.longComment: That said, per Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com, Hafley added that the Dolphins will evaluate the QB's status again depending on how he feels at the end of his minimum required stay on IR. For now, Willis is out for at least three more games, with Kyle McCord currently filling in as 1-9 Miami's starting signal-caller.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Dolphins opened Harrison's (hamstring) 21-day practice window Monday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
status.longComment: Harrison suffered a hamstring injury in Week 1 that landed him on injured reserve. The fact the Dolphins opted to open his practice window after nine weeks suggests Harrison may be nearing a return.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Brents is day-to-day with a shoulder injury, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.
status.longComment: Brents didn't return to Sunday's loss to the Bills after sustaining a shoulder injury. The 26-year-old is still expected to undergo further tests but appears to have avoided anything serious. Brents has 36 tackles (21 solo) and two pass deflections through 10 regular-season games.

status.label: Inactive
status.shortComment: Simpson (knee) is listed as inactive for Sunday's matchup against the Bills.
status.longComment: Simpson was previously doubtful for Sunday's game after not practicing Wednesday or Thursday and ending the week with limited participation. The 26-year-old plays the majority of snaps on special teams, so his absence shouldn't greatly impact the defense.
